codeSystems.name: FijiAllergyAgentVS
codeSystems.title: Allergy Causative Agent Value Set for Fiji Patient
codeSystems.description: A subset of SNOMED CT concepts representing substances or products that cause allergies or intolerances, aligned with global IPS.

codeSystems.name: FijiBodySiteVS
codeSystems.title: Fiji Body Site (Anatomical Structure) Value Set
codeSystems.description:
Valueset for bodysite/anatomical structures.
Used for Condition.bodySite and Immunization.site
Values from SNOMED CT anatomical structures.

codeSystems.name: FijiConditionCodeVS
codeSystems.title: Condition/Diagnosis code valueset
codeSystems.description:
Condition Code valueset for Fiji Core. 
Proposed valueset is taken from SNOMED codes curated for International Patient Summary.
Includes "clinical finding"  codes and codes for "situation with explicit content".

codeSystems.name: FijiDivisionVS
codeSystems.title: Valueset of Fiji Health Administration Divisions
codeSystems.description: A valueset containing Fiji Health Administration Divisions

codeSystems.name: FijiEvidenceVS
codeSystems.title: Condition Evidence Value Set for Fiji Core IG
codeSystems.description: Evidence: Signs, symptoms, procedures, and labs, explicitly excluding formal diseases.

codeSystems.name: FijiMedicalAreaVS
codeSystems.title: Valueset of Fiji Health Administration medical areas
codeSystems.description: A valueset containing Fiji Health Administration  medical areas

codeSystems.name: FijiMedicationRouteVS
codeSystems.title: Fiji Medication and Vaccine Route Value Set
codeSystems.description:
Valueset for medication and vaccine route.
Used for Medications and Immunization.route
Values are descendants from SNOMED CT Route of Administration concept.

codeSystems.name: FijiNursingZoneVS
codeSystems.title: Valueset of Fiji Health Administration nursing zones
codeSystems.description: A valueset containing Fiji Health Administration  nursing zones

codeSystems.name: FijiObsInterpretationVS
codeSystems.title: Fiji Observation Interpretation Value Set
codeSystems.description:
Valueset for interpretations of Observations for Fiji.
Used for interpretaton element for Observations and derived profiles (eg. Vital signs)
Values from  HL7 v3 Code System ObservationInterpretation with added values from WHO/Fiji usage.

codeSystems.name: FijiRadiologyFindingsVS
codeSystems.title: Fiji Radiology/Diagnostic Findings Value Set
codeSystems.description: Fiji radiology findings including SNOMED CT concepts filtered for radiology and imaging findings used within an IPS context.

codeSystems.name: FijiSubDivisionVS
codeSystems.title: Valueset of Fiji Health Administration Sub-divisions
codeSystems.description: A valueset containing Fiji Health Administration sub-divisions

codeSystems.name: FijiVitalBodyWeightVS
codeSystems.title: Fiji Vital Sign Body Weight ValueSet
codeSystems.description:
Concepts representing options that provide further context for body weight coding. (eg.  Birth Weight...)
NOTE: This is not currently used but may be used in future when a full valueset has been developed

codeSystems.name: FijiVitalMethodVS
codeSystems.title: Fiji Vital Sign Measurement Method ValueSet
codeSystems.description:
SNOMED CT concepts representing methods used to obtain vital sign
measurements, including body temperature, blood pressure, body height,
body weight, heart rate, oxygen saturation and respiratory rate.
This may be extended as required including with local codes used in historic data.

codeSystems.name: HeartRateVS
codeSystems.title: Heart Rate LOINC Codes
codeSystems.description: LOINC codes for heart rate measurements, spot or average.

codeSystems.name: ImmVS
codeSystems.title: Immunization ValueSet
codeSystems.description: Immunization valueset based on until Fiji-Pacific valueset is developed

codeSystems.name: ImmStatusReasonVS
codeSystems.title: Immunization Status Reason valueset for reason a vaccine was not administered
codeSystems.description:
Status Reason codes for reason a vaccine was not administered. 
Initial codes used are ICD-11 codes from DAK.
TODO: Converted and/or extend from vaccine specific exception codes from SNOMED CT codes or whatever code system chosen

codeSystems.name: ObsVS
codeSystems.title: Observation ValueSet
codeSystems.description: Use all LOINC codes as temporary observation valueset until Fiji-Pacific valueset is developed
